## What this batch changed

Two production precision defects surfaced here and are fixed in
`packages/core/src/hotspots/match.ts`:

- `把部署章节的截图换成新版` injected `mem-deploy-port` on the shared keyword 部署
  alone. A keyword now decides only when the query is that word (3 tokens or
  fewer) or opens with it — Chinese questions name their topic first, so
  `迁移失败后先做什么` still hits the migration memory.
- `给 orders 表加个 created_at 索引…alembic 迁移脚本` injected the migration memory
  for the same reason.

Effect on this batch: `precision-leak` 9 → 6, `agree` 92 → 94, one recalled
case lost (19 miss instead of 18) because a query that mentions its topic
mid-sentence now stays quiet. The 18-case baseline is unchanged at 11 hit /
7 clean / 0 false positive.

The six remaining leaks are same-topic-different-question drafts (a
Cache-Control header, a token column's storage, connection-pool leak debugging,
an i18n library upgrade). Lexical matching cannot separate those, and two of them
run in `p-memory-eval-other`, where the injected memory is the right one for that
project — so they are label questions, not defects.

The `matcher-weak` rows are the documented conjunctive-search property: their
`search` text is a natural-language question, which the matcher cannot serve.
They belong on `memory_resolve`, not in this dataset.
